notes.title: Updated some interesting game mechanics 0w0
notes.notes: [p]In the previous version, players could recruit neutral creeps. The new version refines this design:[/p][p]At the beginning of the game, players can only summon ordinary soldiers. However, after conquering a certain type of neutral creep, they can recruit this type of creep from their castle.[/p][p]Players can conquer neutral creeps by defeating them, having a priest recruit them, or building a house for them to live in.[/p][p][/p][p]New \[knockback] mechanism added:[/p][p]Some soldiers' attacks have a knockback effect, forcing the knocked-back unit to move a certain distance. The greater the knockback, the greater the distance. Units knocked into water will drown.[/p][p]Currently, the following soldiers have knockback effects:[/p][p]Explosive Barrel: Extremely strong knockback, regardless of friend or foe.[/p][p]Cow with Hammer: Strong knockback.[/p][p]Spearman: Knockback distance determined by current momentum.[/p][p]Warrior: Weak knockback.[/p][p]Goblin Bombardier: Weak knockback.[/p][p][/p][p]A new bridge has been designed that can be destroyed or repaired.[/p][p]Pawns can repair bridges, and Goblins can destroy them.[/p][p]After a bridge is destroyed, soldiers who cannot swim standing on the damaged bridge will drown.[/p][p][/p][p]Hidden Effect: Fish Warriors and Turtles will not drown.[/p][p][/p][p]Modified the design of Skull. Now Skull is the only type of soldier that can be recruited without any resources. The cost is that Skull will take up 4 population slots and the speed of recruiting Skull will be very slow.[/p][p][/p][p]The maximum population limit for each side is now changed to 60 people[/p][p][/p][p]Special Thanks to Pixel Art <Tiny Swords> !~0w0[/p]

notes.title: Many new Neutral Creeps have been added.
notes.notes: [p]Many new Neutral Creeps have been added. [/p][p]Players can defeat Neutral Creeps to increase the level of soldiers, [/p][p]or use priests/houses/resources to recruit these Neutral Creeps.[/p][p][/p][p]Some interesting Neutral Monsters:[/p][p]Turtle: Extremely slow, but with extremely high defense and health. Immune to fire and can extinguish fires.[/p][p]Skull: Resurrects upon first death, but at the cost of having some of its bones discarded...[/p][p]Gnome: Moves and has health similar to a regular soldier. Like a human engineer, it deals high damage to buildings.[/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to pixel art <Tiny Swords> for the new ncredibly beautiful art !~0w0[/p]
